added.summary: Pack slots for the HUD's meters, so a theme restyles them all at once: Bar.frame (.thick, .low), Bar.tone (.mana, .stamina, .shield, .xp, .boss, .low, .invulnerable), Bar.ghost, Bar.tick and Bar.value; Ring.box, Ring.track, Ring.fill (.success, .warn, .danger, .info), Ring.spin and Ring.label; Orb.box, Orb.rim, Orb.well (.mana), Orb.fill (.mana), Orb.glass, Orb.value and Orb.label; Radial.box, Radial.track, Radial.fill (.exhausted) and Radial.sheen; Boss.status and Boss.figure.

fixed.summary: Its figure and name sit on their own ground, so they read on any liquid and over any scene (they fell to 2.3:1 on a health orb's fill).
Invulnerable and Defeated sit on their own ground and read at AA. Its health, stagger bar and notches draw the theme's Bar slots.
Stands 56 px by default (Ring.box), large enough to read its percent on a phone.
Its well, fill colours, ghost, notches and figure draw the Bar slots; StatBar and RadialMeter draw theirs too.
